description: This file contains extension methods for the RequestContext class, enabling import/export of context data and retrieval of reentrancy IDs from message context data in Orleans.

classes.name: RequestContextExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for working with RequestContext, including importing context data, exporting context, and getting reentrancy IDs.

methods.name: Import
methods.description: Imports the provided context data into the current RequestContext, replacing existing values.

methods.name: Export
methods.description: Exports a copy of the current RequestContext's context data using a DeepCopier.

methods.name: GetReentrancyId
methods.description: Retrieves the reentrancy Guid from a message or context data.
